**Limitations**

- Pixels of the same cell always get the same value, so fine detail inside a cell is lost.
- Cells are cut at fixed boundaries, so two similar colors on either side of a boundary are not joined.

**Artifacts**

- Isolated noise pixels with a far-off color stay as specks, alone in their cell.
- Slight banding in smooth ramps, at the brightness boundaries of the cells.
